rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"low","title":"Report filter drops every location-less diagnostic, not only metadata ones","detail":"The new wrapper installed in the TypeCollector constructor forwards a diagnostic only when Location.IsInSource and the compilation contains its tree. Every diagnostic built with a null location becomes Location.None and is silently dropped, including diagnostics about types the compilation owns. Examples: CollidingMemberNamesInForceMapMode falls back to a null location when the previously claimed member has no syntax (for example, it comes from a metadata base class), and PartialTypeRequired or MessageFormatterMustBeMessagePackFormatter may compute a null location. These problems used to be reported without a location and now produce nothing. The requirement does not ask for this; only diagnostics about members of referenced types needed to be skipped.
